title: Technology Sophistication Across Establishments — production-planning MOST-used method
state_structure: Six documented mutually exclusive source categories for the most-used production-planning method: handwritten processes; computers with standard software; mobile apps or digital platforms; specialised software; ERP; other
primary_descriptor: Employment size from e1; country as a secondary synthesis dimension
access_and_reuse: Edited anonymised public distribution; free registered-user download; attribution required; source microdata must not be redistributed without prior written agreement
selection_reason: Best combination of independent IS context; finite documented states; nested definitions; establishment descriptors; large sample; versioned DOI and an official verified reproducibility package. Selection precedes microdata acquisition and all ODSA outputs.

title: 2018 Annual Business Survey — Digital Technology Module
analysis_unit: Published firm-level estimates aggregated by table cell
state_structure: Published technology-use categories can support a bounded aggregate ODSA application subject to a table-level state audit; internal positive-class composition is less complete than in FAT
primary_descriptor: Employment-size class; industry and geography as secondary dimensions
access_and_reuse: Public disclosure-reviewed aggregate tables and API; API key required for current programmatic calls
selection_reason: Strong official aggregate source and clear firm-size descriptors but less suitable for state-composition and record-level recoverability diagnostics.

title: Eurostat Digital Intensity Index
period: Annual; candidate year to be locked at acquisition
state_structure: Four mutually exclusive intensity levels: very low; low; high and very high; at-least-basic is the union of low; high and very high
primary_descriptor: Enterprise size; country as a secondary dimension
access_and_reuse: Public official aggregate statistics; component composition varies by survey year and limits longitudinal comparability
selection_reason: Clear mutually exclusive levels and official size/country breakdowns but the composite indicator is coarsened and its components vary between years.

title: Flash Eurobarometer 486 — SMEs; Start-ups; Scale-ups and Entrepreneurship
state_structure: Digital technologies are primarily separate binary items rather than one documented mutually exclusive multi-state process variable
access_and_reuse: Versioned research dataset; GESIS access conditions apply
selection_reason: Fails the minimum state-granularity threshold. Constructing a count or maturity ladder from separate binary technologies would invent a state structure not directly preserved by the source.

title: Business Trends and Outlook Survey — AI supplement
state_structure: Current AI use and expected use in six months are published as separate questions; public outputs do not preserve a direct joint mutually exclusive state register
selection_reason: Fails the state-granularity threshold because current-only; planned-only; both and neither cannot be recovered from separate published marginal estimates.
